prompt: Our TISAX assessment found nonconformities in access control and supplier management. Walk us through the corrective action process, temporary labels, and deadlines.
assertions: Describes the corrective sequence correctly: nonconformities lead to a corrective action plan assessed by the audit provider (corrective action plan assessment), followed by follow-up assessment(s) verifying implementation
States the temporary-label mechanics: temporary labels may be issued on an approved corrective action plan, and they EXPIRE 9 months after the initial assessment's closing meeting
States the hard deadline: all corrective work and follow-up must complete within the 9-month window — miss it and the assessment must be redone

Gives substantive remediation guidance for the named areas (access control: e.g., joiner-mover-leaver, privileged access, reviews; supplier management: contracts/security requirements, supplier assessment) tied to reaching target maturity 3 given cutback scoring

Covers the practical mechanics: work with the same audit provider for follow-up, evidence-first remediation (documents + operating records), and final labels (3-year validity) shared via the ENX platform once closed
